data.body: Follow-on organic CI evidence while landing this fix: Gerrit 1827 (tests: isolate nested pytest temp cleanup) has LLM-Review +1, zero unresolved comments, but Verified -1 from run 31961655783 / job 95200612653 on Ubuntu 24.04, Python 3.11. The sole failure occurred after 13,517 passes: tests/unit/test_authorship_batched_ticket_map_7084.py::test_batched_map_matches_the_per_event_resolver_for_every_event. The ticket-scoped batched resolver returned an empty map, while the immediately following per-event resolver returned e40a20fd6aa32b4a9ceb3b237b174da80aa3dc20 for position 1000-aaaa1111. Python 3.12, Python 3.13, and macOS lanes passed. This is not being retried. Current source audit shows build_ticket_position_commit_map can yield {} through four observable classes: empty input, tracker/path resolution exception, subprocess exception/nonzero exit, or a zero/unparseable stdout stream. The CI log did not expose which class because the batched helper swallows diagnostics. No claim is yet made that this is the prior freshly-missing-object mechanism; the next step is a runtime trace / fault-injected reproduction that distinguishes those classes and tests whether another unisolated nested pytest cleanup can disturb this active tmp_path repository.
